text: Start from Sense Event and a nearby event card as before. New here: if your phone's clock is off, the Scan screen says so and offers Check again — tell us if that warning shows up when your clock looks fine. While serving, confirm the event ID on screen is the event you actually joined. On the wallet side, an unsupported smart wallet now ends with Close instead of Try Again, and connecting with MetaMask should no longer say you are not connected after you approve the signature.
